name: comment-slop
description: Find and remove AI-slop comments — ones that restate the code, describe another layer's behavior, or narrate planning that never shipped — while protecting the comments that carry real reasoning. Use when a reviewer calls a comment useless or AI-written, when auditing comments and docstrings on a branch or PR, or before sending a change for review. Encodes a three-clause test, a seven-mode taxonomy, a diff-scoped keep/rewrite/delete workflow, and an ASD-STE100 style pass for survivors.
